runtimeNetwork: All assets are self-hosted; no remote calls at runtime.
rendering: Star map uses a low-exposure unlit material (#2b2d30), no synthetic blinking or nebulae. Earth radius 82 at camera-relative [-645,-285,-560], cloud radius 82.27, atmosphere radius 82.8. Shared world-space SUN_DIRECTION illuminates all three layers.

assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Ernie Wright, Deep Star Maps 2020
assets.processing: Official 4K floating-point EXR decoded with ffmpeg; RGB display gamma pow(linear,1/2.2), clamped to LDR, WebP quality 93 method 6. No synthetic stars added.
assets.usage: NASA SVS media usage guidelines apply; credit NASA SVS. See source page for dataset credits.

assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Eric Sokolowsky. Blue Marble Next Generation data courtesy of Reto Stockli (NASA/GSFC) and NASA's Earth Observatory.
assets.processing: Converted RGB to WebP quality 90; sRGB display color.
assets.usage: Official SVS help page states content is public domain unless otherwise noted. Source page and requested credit verified by direct HTTPS on 2026-11-06; static imagery only.

assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; visualizer Cindy Starr; GEOS-5 atmospheric model, NASA GMAO.
assets.processing: Extracted TIFF alpha, Lanczos downsampled to 1024x512; lossless WebP linear density.
assets.usage: Official SVS help page states content is public domain unless otherwise noted. Source page and requested credit verified by direct HTTPS on 2026-11-06; static cloud alpha frame only, no audio.

assets.credit: Derived in PocketWorld from NASA SVS 2915 Blue Marble.
assets.processing: Approximate mask: clamp((B-max(R,G)-7)/15,0,1)*clamp((110-max(R,G,B))/50,0,1), computed at 1024x512; lossless WebP.
assets.usage: Locally derived from NASA SVS 2915 static imagery. SVS help page and image credit verified by direct HTTPS on 2026-11-06; source attribution retained.

earthProvenanceNote: Earth surface now comes directly from NASA SVS 2915. Cloud alpha is a single GEOS-5 model visualization frame from SVS 3837, not live weather. Ocean mask is an approximate blue-water classification derived locally from the NASA surface; not scientific bathymetry or ocean observations.
